sourceRestSoleRepair.cause: Requested neutral soles differed from the registered source Foot.end. This forced both IK legs away from their own shoes even before stride; samurai and several side views had a large one-sided translation.
sourceRestSoleRepair.change: Rest soles use the exact same source shoe endpoints as the connected ankle/foot UV parts. No compressed lateral lane or translated replacement stance; original anchors, pelvis, UVs, bones and gait timing retained.
sourceRestSoleRepair.runtimeValidation: Not run. Source and original artwork inspection only; player gameplay validation remains pending.

locomotionRepair02.implementation: native/painted_actor_renderer.gd; common two-leg projected contact solver
locomotionRepair02.groundBasis: Unproject actual screen displacement by 2:1 source camera, then use the same projected forward for cycle distance and foot sweep. Body/weapon facing remains separately owned.
locomotionRepair02.support: Ankles walk under their own source hips with original per-leg ground depth. Cycle length is bounded by original thigh/shin reach plus bounded support pelvis correction, not gameplay speed changes.
locomotionRepair02.contacts: 0.62 cycle stance and half-cycle alternation; Hermite swing matches planted derivative, squared-sine toe clearance and rotation have zero endpoint derivative.
locomotionRepair02.transitions: Simulation-clock blend, retained distance phase, planted points stored in canonical position plus body-height-relative offset; source rest recovered after stopping.
locomotionRepair02.upperBody: Anatomical-pelvis counterrotation of coherent shoulders/held-arms/weapon, no generic free-arm mask and no whole-sprite bob.
locomotionRepair02.validation: Source and analytical inspection only; no engine, preflight, game test or profiling run. Actual rendered gait is pending user play verification.
locomotionRepair02.remainingLimits: Source-specific UV limb motion and a coherent upper-body island are retained. This is not a new authored full-body gait. Reach-limited source views still have different cycle lengths; bounded contact release handles unreachable contacts on a view/pivot. Actual attack poses are not blended; distance phase is retained through them.
